_documentation: Email Template Seed Data - Insert via POST /v1/submit/email-templates
_instructions: Use these templates as seed data. Insert each template using the Universal Form API.

templates._comment: 1. CUSTOMER WELCOME EMAIL - Sent to customer after successful registration

formData.name: Customer Welcome Email
formData.subject: Welcome to CineQ, {{firstName}}! 🎬
formData.message:
Welcome to CineQ! 🎬

Hi {{firstName}},

Thank you for joining CineQ - your premier destination for movie ticket booking!

Your account has been created successfully with the following details:

  • Email: {{email}}
  • Account ID: {{customerId}}

Here's what you can do now:

  • 🎥 Browse the latest movies
  • 🎟️ Book tickets for your favorite shows
  • ⭐ Earn loyalty points with every purchase
  • 🎁 Get exclusive member offers
{{#if emailVerificationRequired}}

Important: Please verify your email to activate your account:

Verify Email Address

Or copy this link: {{verificationLink}}

This link expires in 24 hours.

{{/if}}

Start exploring movies now!

Browse Movies

If you didn't create this account, please ignore this email or contact support.

© {{year}} CineQ. All rights reserved.
formData.adminMessage:
🎉 New Customer Registration

A new customer has registered on CineQ:

FieldValue
Name{{firstName}} {{lastName}}
Email{{email}}
Phone{{phone}}
Customer ID{{customerId}}
Registered At{{registeredAt}}
Email Verified{{isEmailVerified}}

View customer in admin panel: {{adminUrl}}/customers/{{customerId}}

This is an automated notification from CineQ.

placeholders.{{emailVerificationRequired}}: Boolean - if email verification is enabled

templates._comment: 2. EMAIL VERIFICATION - Sent when customer needs to verify email

formData.name: Email Verification
formData.subject: Verify Your Email - CineQ
formData.message:
Verify Your Email Address

Hi {{firstName}},

Please verify your email address to complete your CineQ registration and start booking movie tickets.

Verify Email Address
⏰ This link expires in 24 hours.

If you can't click the button, copy and paste this link into your browser:

{{verificationLink}}

Once verified, you'll be able to:

  • Book movie tickets
  • Earn loyalty points
  • Access exclusive offers

If you didn't create a CineQ account, please ignore this email.

© {{year}} CineQ. All rights reserved.

templates._comment: 3. FORGOT PASSWORD - Sent when customer requests password reset

formData.name: Password Reset Request
formData.subject: Reset Your Password - CineQ
formData.message:
Reset Your Password

Hi {{firstName}},

We received a request to reset your password for your CineQ account associated with {{email}}.

Reset Password
⏰ This link expires in {{expiryHours}} hours.

If you can't click the button, copy and paste this link into your browser:

{{resetLink}}

🔒 Security Notice

If you didn't request this password reset, please ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.

For security, this request was received from:

  • IP Address: {{ipAddress}}
  • Time: {{requestTime}}

Need help? Contact our support team.

© {{year}} CineQ. All rights reserved.

templates._comment: 4. PASSWORD CHANGED CONFIRMATION - Sent after successful password reset

formData.name: Password Changed Confirmation
formData.subject: Your Password Has Been Changed - CineQ
formData.message:
Password Changed Successfully

Hi {{firstName}},

✅ Your password has been changed successfully.

Your CineQ account password was changed on {{changedAt}}.

You can now log in with your new password.

🔒 Wasn't you?

If you didn't make this change, your account may be compromised. Please:

  1. Reset your password immediately
  2. Contact our support team
  3. Review your recent account activity

This is an automated security notification.

© {{year}} CineQ. All rights reserved.

templates._comment: 5. ACCOUNT LOCKED - Sent when account is locked due to failed attempts

formData.name: Account Locked Notification
formData.subject: 🔒 Your CineQ Account Has Been Locked
formData.message:
Account Locked

Hi {{firstName}},

⚠️ Your account has been temporarily locked.

Due to {{failedAttempts}} failed login attempts, your account has been locked for security reasons.

Lock expires: {{lockExpiresAt}}

Lockout duration: {{lockoutMinutes}} minutes

If this was you, simply wait for the lockout period to expire and try again with the correct password.

If you've forgotten your password, you can reset it:

Reset Password
🛡️ Not you?

If you didn't attempt to log in, someone may be trying to access your account. We recommend:

  1. Reset your password immediately
  2. Enable two-factor authentication (if available)
  3. Contact support if suspicious activity continues

This is an automated security notification.

© {{year}} CineQ. All rights reserved.
formData.adminMessage:
🔒 Account Locked Alert

A customer account has been locked due to multiple failed login attempts:

FieldValue
Customer{{firstName}} {{lastName}}
Email{{email}}
Customer ID{{customerId}}
Failed Attempts{{failedAttempts}}
Locked At{{lockedAt}}
Lock Expires{{lockExpiresAt}}
Last Failed IP{{ipAddress}}

This may indicate a brute-force attack. Monitor for repeated lockouts.

CineQ Security System
